title: Audio Dope's latest single, "Honestly" ft. Birdmask is a catchy pop tune
htmlContent:
Audio Dope's latest single, "Honestly" ft. Birdmask is a charming and dreamy pop tune that showcases the Swiss artist and producer's ability to genre-hop between trip-hop, electronica, and lo-fi hip-hop. With a smooth and catchy melody, the song is perfect for anyone in the mood for easy-listening pop music.

Featuring the vocals of fellow Basel artist Birdmask, "Honestly" alludes to the first day of the last day of summer, making it a perfect track to add to your summer playlist. The lyrics are simple yet heartfelt, and the production is polished and well-crafted.

Audio Dope's track "Honestly" is the perfect teaser that promises to be a dynamic and exciting project with its eclectic mix of genres and guest features.

The song "Honestly" is an excellent addition to Audio Dope's discography and a must-listen for anyone who enjoys well-crafted pop music with a dreamy edge. The track is a testament to Audio Dope's musical versatility and Birdmask's vocal prowess, and it's sure to leave you humming along to its infectious melody.
